pending.body: In `test_mature_stable_tank_breeds_well()` at `reproduction_factors.rs:1353-1357`, the test counts `ShrimpBerried` events as 'reproductive cycles' (`berried_events >= 3`). The acceptance criteria specify 'at least three reproductive cycles observed,' which implies complete spawn→incubation→hatch→juvenile cycles. A spawning event that is followed by egg dropping or hatch failure does not constitute a complete cycle. The test should additionally verify that `ShrimpHatched` events (or equivalent) also reach at least 3 to confirm complete cycle completion, or track juveniles-produced events across the 2000-hour window.

Unify the alkalinity stoichiometry source across runtime defaults and preset/scenario loading. `ProcessParams::default()` now uses `NITRIFICATION_ALK_MEQ_PER_MG_N` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:338`, but the preset-side defaults still hard-code `0.1428` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:1018` and the shipped process preset still serializes `0.1428` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_data/data/process/default.toml:54`. Because scenarios copy the preset value verbatim at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:391-392`, the same tank now consumes different alkalinity depending on whether it was built via `TankState::new()` or via the shipped preset path.

Fix the new nitrogen-cycle trace output so the nitrogen quantity matches the alkalinity quantity it is emitted next to. The trace now emits `nitrogen_cycle.total_n_nitrified_mg` and `nitrogen_cycle.alk_consumed_meq` together at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-238`, but `total_mg_n_nitrified` is computed as `nob_step + comammox_step` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:343-346` while alkalinity consumption is computed from `aob_alk_cost + comammox_alk_cost` at `/home/master/p/tank-simulation/.claude/worktrees/tanksim-6e5.4.7/crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366-384`. In any tick where AOB produces nitrite faster than NOB clears it, the trace can report positive alkalinity consumption alongside zero or underreported `total_n_nitrified_mg`, which makes the new diagnostics scientifically misleading.
